selectionRationale: River Park Events possesses an unmistakable physical aura: dramatic crystal chandeliers in Sala Grand combined with signature low-lying smoke ('dans pe nori') and cold sparkler fountains. This territory elevates the venue from a physical space to a stage of cinematic grandeur, capturing the emotional dream of a couple's first dance floating above celestial clouds.
businessTruth: River Park Events is a premier event estate in Drăgășani featuring two expansive halls (Sala Grand and Sala Gold), an elite on-site culinary kitchen, and an integrated 19-room boutique hotel on Strada Regele Ferdinand 56.
humanInsight: Couples and hosts don't just book a hall; they seek a transformative theatrical backdrop where their most significant milestone feels like an unrepeatable cinematic premiere.
creativeMetaphor: A nocturnal theater of light and haze, where monumental architecture cradles celestial celebrations.
centralMechanism: Atmospheric Lighting & Cloud State Switcher: an interactive curtain trigger that transitions the scene from crisp architectural clarity to low-lying haze illuminated by cold sparklers.
signatureMoment: The 'Dans pe Nori' Atmospheric Reveal: users drag an interactive light curtain across Sala Grand, unveiling the dramatic shift from formal banquet setup to a misty cloud-floored ballroom beneath crystal chandeliers.

interactionGrammar.paceAndMotion: Deliberate, theatrical, cinematic inertia. Transitions flow like stage curtains opening with heavy, luxurious ease.
interactionGrammar.openingMoment: Full-bleed nocturnal reveal of Sala Grand's crystal chandeliers dimming down as volumetric haze creeps across the screen floor.
interactionGrammar.scrollChoreography: Dual-axis curtain reveal: horizontal slide transitions for hall comparison (Sala Grand vs. Sala Gold) and vertical sticky pinning for atmospheric transformation.
microInteractions: Cursor glow reacting to ambient hall light switchers
selectedPatterns: Bespoke date and hall concierge switch
rejectedPatterns: No generic cards with floating drop shadows

typography.styleNote: Regal serif display headings with delicate letter spacing, balanced by razor-sharp geometric sans-serif body copy.

visualGrammar.spatialComposition: Asymmetric full-bleed layouts with dramatic dark contrast, deep focal depth, and heavy framing around lighting accents.

forbiddenAntiPatterns: Do not reference direct physical river access or riverbanks
Do not claim hotel capacity beyond 19 guest rooms
Do not use bright white daylight background palettes
Do not display generic flat cards without lighting context
mandatoryDesignRules: All imagery must strictly feature authentic River Park venue assets
All text in Romanian must express understated luxury and refined hospitality
Interactive controls must simulate real physical effects (light, smoke, sparklers)
Always ground physical location accurately at Strada Regele Ferdinand 56, Drăgășani

scenes.purpose: Set the nocturnal atmosphere and introduce River Park Events as a stage of grand spectacle.
scenes.title: Preludiu Nocturn
scenes.subtitle: Scena Evenimentelor Grandioase din Drăgășani
scenes.bodyText: Pași scurși în lumină caldă, candelabre de cristal ce veghează din înalt și o atmosferă creată pentru momente memorabile. River Park Events transformă fiecare sărbătoare într-un spectacol cinematografic.
scenes.layoutPattern: Full-bleed split curtain reveal with centered high-impact typography
scenes.keyInteraction: Drag vertical curtain to dim the lights and reveal crystal chandeliers
scenes.visualEffect: Volumetric ambient glow with subtle floating dust particle animation

scenes.purpose: Showcase the dual event spaces: Sala Grand and Sala Gold.
scenes.title: Două Spații, O Singură Viziune
scenes.subtitle: Sala Grand & Sala Gold
scenes.bodyText: Fie că vă doriți măreția neoclasică a Sălii Grand sau rafinamentul cald al Sălii Gold, spațiile noastre se adaptează impecabil dimensiunii și caracterului evenimentului dumneavoastră.
scenes.keyInteraction: Toggle between Sala Grand and Sala Gold layout perspectives
scenes.visualEffect: Smooth cross-dissolve with golden architectural outline highlights

scenes.purpose: Highlight the signature 'Dans pe Nori' smoke and cold firework special effects.
scenes.title: Dans pe Nori
scenes.subtitle: Efecte Speciale & Artificii Reci
scenes.bodyText: Trăiți primul dans învăluiți în fum greu și scântei spectaculoase de artificii reci. O experiență vizuală desăvârșită ce transformă ringul de dans într-o scenă celestă.
scenes.layoutPattern: Interactive state-toggle before and after cloud transition canvas
scenes.keyInteraction: Hold cursor or touch to activate low-lying cloud smoke simulation
scenes.visualEffect: Particle haze simulation layered over high-contrast ballroom lighting

scenes.purpose: Demonstrate the culinary expertise of the on-site kitchen and custom menus.

scenes.subtitle: Bucătărie Proprie & Meniuri Personalizate
scenes.bodyText: Preparate create cu pasiune în bucătăria noastră proprie. De la aranjamente spectaculoase la preparate rafinate, fiecare meniu este conceput pentru a încânta cele mai exigente gusturi.
scenes.layoutPattern: Offset editorial magazine layout with focus callouts
scenes.keyInteraction: Hover over menu elements to reveal culinary detail shots
scenes.visualEffect: Subtle depth-of-field lens tilt on image hover

scenes.purpose: Introduce the integrated 19-room River Park Hotel for host and guest accommodation.

scenes.subtitle: Hotel River Park — 19 Camere Elegante
scenes.bodyText: Prelungiți bucuria evenimentului într-un cadru intim și odihnitor. Cele 19 camere ale Hotelului River Park oferă confortul desăvârșit pentru dumneavoastră și invitații dumneavoastră de seamă.

scenes.keyInteraction: Swipe through room gallery preview cards
scenes.visualEffect: Soft fade-in gallery transitions with subtle warm light leaks

scenes.subtitle: Strada Regele Ferdinand 56, Drăgășani
scenes.bodyText: Echipa noastră vă stă la dispoziție pentru a planifica fiecare detaliu al evenimentului dumneavoastră. Selectați data dorită și începeți călătoria către o celebrare memorabilă.
